description: Synthetic technical-memory smoke fixture. Not LongMemEval or LoCoMo.

documents.content: Payment service persists invoices into PostgreSQL and caches sessions in Redis.
The API uses JWT authentication signed with RS256; verify issuer and audience on every request.
Post-deployment rollback restores the last green revision using Argo Rollouts.
Incidents are paged via PagerDuty; on-call escalation starts after five minutes.
The contract is audited by the security team before upgrading the Cosmos chain.
Python unit tests run with pytest and linting is done using Ruff.
The frontend uses React Router, CSS modules and responsive layout tokens.
The search stack combines Elasticsearch keyword retrieval and Qdrant vector similarity.
Orders are published to Kafka, keyed by customer ID to preserve per-customer ordering.
Prometheus gathers histogram metrics and Grafana displays p95 HTTP request latency.
Test accounts are provisioned by the staging fixture with synthetic identities.
We use an explicit ACL for every memory recall based on tenant, agent, purpose and clearance.
